summary: Unicycive Therapeutics filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 solely to disclose a preliminary unaudited cash balance of approximately $61.4 million as of June 30, 2026. The filing contains no terms or events related to a special situation (e.g., acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or management change). It is a routine liquidity update with no board recommendation, advisor, structural mechanics, or risk-arb angle.
